00074         inline vFloat VEC_MUL_OP(vFloat const& leftVec, vFloat const& rightVec)
00075         {
00076             vFloat returnVec;
00077             float *returnFloat = (float *) &returnVec;
00078             float *leftFloat = (float *) &leftVec;
00079             float *rightFloat = (float *) &rightVec;
00080             
00081             returnFloat[0] = leftFloat[0] * rightFloat[0];
00082             returnFloat[1] = leftFloat[1] * rightFloat[1];
00083             returnFloat[2] = leftFloat[2] * rightFloat[2];
00084             returnFloat[3] = leftFloat[3] * rightFloat[3];
00085             
00086             return returnVec;
00087         }
00088 
00089         inline vFloat VEC_ADD_OP(vFloat const& leftVec, vFloat const& rightVec)
00090         {
00091             vFloat returnVec;
00092             float *returnFloat = (float *) &returnVec;
00093             float *leftFloat = (float *) &leftVec;
00094             float *rightFloat = (float *) &rightVec;
00095             
00096             returnFloat[0] = leftFloat[0] + rightFloat[0];
00097             returnFloat[1] = leftFloat[1] + rightFloat[1];
00098             returnFloat[2] = leftFloat[2] + rightFloat[2];
00099             returnFloat[3] = leftFloat[3] + rightFloat[3];
00100             
00101             return returnVec;
00102         }
00103 
00104         inline vFloat VEC_SUB_OP(vFloat const& leftVec, vFloat const& rightVec)
00105         {
00106             vFloat returnVec;
00107             float *returnFloat = (float *) &returnVec;
00108             float *leftFloat = (float *) &leftVec;
00109             float *rightFloat = (float *) &rightVec;
00110             
00111             returnFloat[0] = leftFloat[0] - rightFloat[0];
00112             returnFloat[1] = leftFloat[1] - rightFloat[1];
00113             returnFloat[2] = leftFloat[2] - rightFloat[2];
00114             returnFloat[3] = leftFloat[3] - rightFloat[3];
00115             
00116             return returnVec;
00117         }

00150     // e.g. fftsize=8
00151     //            | Positive FFT   | Negative FFT
00152     //Bin         | Real part      | imaginary part  | imaginary part
00153     //------------+----------------+-----------------+----------------0 
00154     //0  dc       | f [0]          | 0               | 0
00155     //1           | f [1]          | f [5]           | -f [5]
00156     //2           | f [2],         | f [6]           | -f [6]
00157     //3           | f [3]          | f [7]           | -f [7]
00158     //4  nyquist  | f [4]          | 0               | 0
00159     //
00160     //... mirror:
00161     //
00162     //5           | f [3]          | -f [7]          | f [7]
00163     //6           | f [2]          | -f [6]          | f [6]
00164     //7           | f [1]          | -f [5]          | f [5]
00165 #endif

00206     inline void fft(DSPSplitComplex& outputBuffer, const float* const inputBuffer) throw()
00207     {
00208         ugen_assert(inputBuffer != 0);
00209         
00210 #ifdef UGEN_FFTW
00211         memcpy(transformBufferSamples, inputBuffer, fftSizeBytes);
00212         fftwf_execute(fftwPlan);
00213 
00214         float nyquist = transformBufferSamples[fftSize]; // remember nyquist val
00215         float *interleavedSamples = transformBufferSamples;
00216         // deinteleave
00217         for(int j = 0; j < fftSizeHalved; j++)
00218         {
00219             outputBuffer.realp[j] = *interleavedSamples++;
00220             outputBuffer.imagp[j] = *interleavedSamples++;
00221         }
00222         outputBuffer.imagp[0] = nyquist; // pack nyquist in
00223         
00224 #elif defined(UGEN_FFTREAL)
00225         fftReal->do_fft(transformBufferSamples, inputBuffer);
00226         memcpy(outputBuffer.realp, transformBufferSplit.realp, fftSizeHalvedBytes);
00227         memcpy(outputBuffer.imagp, transformBufferSplit.imagp, fftSizeHalvedBytes);
00228         
00229 #else
00230         static float scale = 0.5f;
00231         vDSP_vsmul(inputBuffer, 1, &scale, transformBufferSamples, 1, fftSize);
00232         ctoz ((COMPLEX *) transformBufferSamples, 2, &outputBuffer, 1, fftSizeHalved);
00233         fft_zrip (fftvDSP, &outputBuffer, 1, fftSizeLog2, FFT_FORWARD);
00234         
00235 #endif
00236     }

00238     void fft(DSPSplitComplex& outputBuffer, const float* const inputBuffer, const bool applyWindow) throw();

00240     void ifft(Buffer const& outputBuffer,

00244               const int outputChannel = 0,
00245               const int inputChannel = 0) throw();
00246     
00247     inline void ifft(float* const outputBuffer, DSPSplitComplex const& inputBuffer) throw()
00248     {
00249         ugen_assert(outputBuffer != 0);
00250         
00251 #ifdef UGEN_FFTW    
00252         LOCAL_DECLARE(const int, fftSize);
00253         LOCAL_DECLARE(const int, fftSizeHalved);
00254         LOCAL_DECLARE(const int, fftSizeBytes);
00255         LOCAL_DECLARE(const int, fftSizeHalvedBytes);
00256         
00257         LOCAL_DECLARE(float * const, transformBufferSamples);
00258         LOCAL_DECLARE(DSPSplitComplex&, transformBufferSplit);
00259 
00260         float *interleavedSamples = transformBufferSamples;
00261         for(int j = 0; j < fftSizeHalved; j++)
00262         {
00263             *interleavedSamples++ = inputBuffer.realp[j];
00264             *interleavedSamples++ = inputBuffer.imagp[j];
00265         }
00266         transformBufferSamples[fftSize  ] = transformBufferSamples[1]; // nyquist
00267         transformBufferSamples[fftSize+1] = 0.f; // nyquist imag always zero
00268         transformBufferSamples[1        ] = 0.f; // DC imag always zero
00269         
00270         fftwf_execute(ifftwPlan);
00271         memcpy(outputBuffer, transformBufferSamples, fftSizeBytes);
00272 #elif defined(UGEN_FFTREAL)
00273         memcpy(transformBufferSplit.realp, inputBuffer.realp, fftSizeBytes);
00274 #else
00275         memcpy(transformBufferSplit.realp, inputBuffer.realp, fftSizeBytes);
00276         fft_zrip (fftvDSP, &transformBufferSplit, 1, fftSizeLog2, FFT_INVERSE);
00277         ztoc (&transformBufferSplit, 1, (COMPLEX *) outputBuffer, 2, fftSizeHalved);
00278 #endif      
00279     }

00330 #if !defined(UGEN_VFP) // && !defined(UGEN_NEON)
00331 inline void MultAndAdd(DSPSplitComplex& In1, DSPSplitComplex& In2, DSPSplitComplex& Out, const int VecLength) throw()
00332 {
00333     ugen_assert(VecLength > 0);
00334     
00335     vFloat *InReal1 = (vFloat *) In1.realp;
00336     vFloat *InImag1 = (vFloat *) In1.imagp;
00337     vFloat *InReal2 = (vFloat *) In2.realp;
00338     vFloat *InImag2 = (vFloat *) In2.imagp;
00339     vFloat *OutReal = (vFloat *) Out.realp;
00340     vFloat *OutImag = (vFloat *) Out.imagp;
00341     ZEROINIT
00342     
00343     float Nyquist1, Nyquist2;
00344     Nyquist1 = In1.imagp[0];
00345     Nyquist2 = In2.imagp[0];
00346     
00347     In1.imagp[0] = 0.f;
00348     In2.imagp[0] = 0.f;
00349     
00350     Out.imagp[0] += Nyquist1 * Nyquist2;
00351     
00352     for (int i = 0; i < VecLength; i++)
00353     {
00354         OutReal[i] = VEC_ADD_OP (OutReal[i], VEC_SUB_OP (VEC_MUL_OP(InReal1[i], InReal2[i] ZEROARG), VEC_MUL_OP(InImag1[i], InImag2[i] ZEROARG)));
00355         OutImag[i] = VEC_ADD_OP (OutImag[i], VEC_ADD_OP (VEC_MUL_OP(InReal1[i], InImag2[i] ZEROARG), VEC_MUL_OP(InImag1[i], InReal2[i] ZEROARG)));
00356     }
00357     
00358     In1.imagp[0] = Nyquist1;
00359     In2.imagp[0] = Nyquist2;
00360 }
00361 #endif
